newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures end up on late-session spec buying.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures end up on late-session spec buying.

text.p: FCOJ futures recouped earlier losses to close firmer and near the day's highs on speculative buying that emerged near the close, dealers said.
The most-active May contract rallied to resistance pegged at the nine-day moving average of 82.75 cents but settled below the key price.
The contract ended up 0.90 cent at 82.50 cents per pound, traded 82.75 to 80.65. Spot March closed 1.10 higher at 79.80.
Volume was estimated at 3,500 lots compared with Tuesday's official volume of 3,276 lots.
Activity could thin while prices consolidate ahead of the March delivery period. The contract's last trading day is March 10.
Market sources called today's move up a temporary correction to an oversold conditon, adding that prices are likely to weaken amid a negative technical outlook and bearish fundamentals.
"A little move like this doesn't change the overall picture and the longer term outlook is still soft," an analyst said.
She said May could rally to 87.00 cents before retreating. Support in May was seen the recent low of 77.50 cents.
A consistently weak weekly movement and ample juice supplies could keep the market under some fundamental pressure, analysts said.

The weather forecast for Florida calls for warm temperatures for the remainder of the week. Temperatures could turn cooler late next week but meteorologists said it is too soon to issue a reliable forecast.
